name: io.github.JGCoelho/simple-sagemath-mcp
title: Simple Sage MCP
description: One persistent SageMath kernel: jobs outlive timeouts, the kernel outlives the server.

environmentVariables.name: SAGE_PYTHON
environmentVariables.description: Interpreter that can `import sage.all` (the kernel). Discovered from `SAGE_PYTHON`, then `sage -c`, then the python beside `sage` on PATH.

environmentVariables.name: SAGE_MCP_STATE
environmentVariables.description: State directory identifying the kernel (default: /tmp/sage-mcp-$UID). Clients that share it share one kernel.

environmentVariables.name: SAGE_CWD
environmentVariables.description: Working directory for `exec` and `run_file` (default: the server's cwd).

environmentVariables.name: SAGE_MCP_LIMITS
environmentVariables.description: Per-process limits for the kernel and its children, e.g. cpu=3600,as=8G,fsize=1G,nproc=off (the defaults).

environmentVariables.name: SAGE_MCP_GAP_LIMIT
environmentVariables.description: GAP crash-loop markers before one SIGINT (default 3; 0 disables the guard).

environmentVariables.name: SAGE_MCP_LOG_MAX
environmentVariables.description: Size at which kernel.log is rotated to kernel.log.1 (default 8 MiB; 0 disables).
